title: City Sees Improvements in Employee Safety Through Various Initiatives
summary: Syracuse has achieved significant workplace safety improvements through data-driven, proactive initiatives rather than reactive protocols. Key successes include elimination of shoulder injuries in waste collection (41% to 0%) following 2023 cart automation, mandatory OSHA training reducing new claims 73%, and a stay-at-work program cutting overall claim costs 50.3% in 2025. The city has invested in Slip, Trip, and Fall simulator training and structured recovery programs across multiple departments.
